question: Should the remaining work be a Signal-specific hidden-body/attachment-only delivery fix, or a new cross-channel `messages` media-placeholder suppression setting?
rationale: Current main already fixed iMessage locally, while the remaining Signal path may be solvable without adding global config; adding a `messages` option is a product/config-surface decision under repository policy.

options.title: Prefer Signal-specific fix
options.body: Keep default behavior compatible and repair the remaining Signal visible-caption path with focused transport proof before adding global config.

options.title: Add global messages setting
options.body: Introduce a documented default-off `messages` suppression option with schema, metadata, docs, and cross-channel tests if maintainers want user policy control.

options.title: Defer pending live proof
options.body: Keep the issue open until a contributor supplies live Signal proof showing which transport-safe replacement works best.

recommendation.title: Prefer Signal-specific fix
recommendation.body: Keep default behavior compatible and repair the remaining Signal visible-caption path with focused transport proof before adding global config.
